svg.title: F-12 guide-word scenes
svg.desc: Guide-word scenes for F-12 Signal intent to other road users. M01 No function: No indicator before a turn or lane change, or no hazard lights at a stop in lane; others are not warned (H-09). M02 Stops functioning: Indicator stops before the manoeuvre ends; as M01 (H-09, rated as M01). M03 Unrequested function: An indicator with no manoeuvre; others yield or move for a turn that does not come (H-09). M04 Function stuck: Indicator stays on after the manoeuvre; as M03 (H-09, rated as M03). M08 Functions late: Indicator late; as no indicator for the moment that matters (H-09, rated as M01). M09 Applies too short: Indicator too short; as M01 (H-09, rated as M01). M10 Applies too long: Indicator too long; as M03 (H-09, rated as M03). M11 Delayed: Indicator delayed; as M08 (H-09, rated as M01). M12 Inverse function: The other side indicated; others move into the path the vehicle takes (H-09). M13 Erratic or intermittent: Indicator flickers between sides; at its worst as M03 (H-09, rated as M03).
svg.text: F-12 Signal intent to other road users: what each malfunction does
WP-C-03 §6.1, Figure 6-4 (F-12): the 10 safety-related guide words, 3 rated and 7 folded into another. Schematic, not simulation results.
